blob.description: The content key of the bytes these rows describe

variant.description: How the bytes were parsed: `json` strict (no comments, no trailing commas), `jsonc` with comments and trailing commas, `yaml` as a YAML 1.2 stream under the core schema (every document, aliases expanded, `<<` a plain key), `ini` an `.npmrc` read by npm's `ini` package as one object holding only its allowlisted top-level keys (every other key and every section dropped)

doc.description: 0-based document ordinal within the file; JSON has one, 0; a YAML stream 0..n-1

parent.description: The parent node's ordinal, or null at the root

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer of the node; the empty string at the root

key.description: The member key, or null for an array element or the root

idx.description: The 0-based array index, or null for a member or the root

depth.description: The root is 1; each child is its parent's depth plus 1

type.description: The node's type as the source wrote it

value.description: A scalar node's value: the string, number or boolean; null for null, an object or an array

lexeme.description: A number's source text, or null for any other type

tag.description: The node's explicit tag as YAML resolves it (`!!str` is `tag:yaml.org,2002:str`, `!foo` stays `!foo`), or null when the source wrote none; always null for JSON

aliasOf.description: The ordinal of the node this row copies when a YAML alias expanded it (the anchored node for the alias's own row, the corresponding row for each copied descendant), or null when no alias produced it

shadowed.description: Whether a later sibling with the same key shadows this node or an ancestor (the last occurrence wins)

line.description: 1-based line, over the decoded text (BOM stripped); CR, LF and CRLF each one break; at the member's key when it has one
